svg.aria-label: An 80 MHz Wi-Fi channel divided into hundreds of narrow subcarriers, and the arithmetic that gives the laptop's 702 megabits per second
svg.text: One 80 MHz channel, split into 256 narrow subcarriers (242 shown to scale)
blue: 234 carry data · orange: 8 “pilots” for keeping in tune

figure.figcaption: Chapter 17’s rule again: symbols per second × bits per symbol × lanes. Here the lanes are subcarriers and antennas.
